+"""Actual model bridge disclosure and validation, with inert local handlers.
+
+No server, provider, credential or network is used. A real scoped registry,
+the normal schema compiler and normal dispatcher retain their production
+profile, concrete-schema, hook and middleware behavior.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+import uuid
+
+
+class DeferredSchemaDisclosureTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        from hermes_constants import set_hermes_home_override
+        from tools.registry import registry
+        from model_tools import get_tool_definitions, handle_function_call
+        from toolsets import session_disabled_toolsets
+
+        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.home = Path(self.directory.name) / "original"
+        self.home.mkdir()
+        (self.home / "config.yaml").write_text("{}\n")
+        self.token = set_hermes_home_override(self.home)
+        self.registry = registry
+        self.definitions = get_tool_definitions
+        self.dispatch = handle_function_call
+        suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex
+        self.toolset = "mcp-schema-proof-" + suffix
+        self.name = "mcp_schema_proof_" + suffix
+        self.calls = []
+        self.disabled = session_disabled_toolsets(None, "cli", oneshot=True)
+        self.parameters = {
+            "oneOf": [
+                {"type": "object", "properties": {"action": {"const": "status"}},
+                 "required": ["action"], "additionalProperties": False},
+                {"type": "object", "properties": {
+                    "action": {"const": "acknowledge_result"},
+                    "result": {"type": "object", "properties": {
+                        "digest": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$"}},
+                        "required": ["digest"], "additionalProperties": False}},
+                 "required": ["action", "result"], "additionalProperties": False},
+            ],
+        }
+
+        def inert(arguments, **_options):
+            self.calls.append(copy.deepcopy(arguments))
+            return json.dumps({"inert": True, "arguments": arguments})
+
+        self.schema = {"name": self.name, "description": "Inert closed union contract",
+                       "parameters": copy.deepcopy(self.parameters)}
+        registry.register(self.name, self.toolset, self.schema, inert, scope=str(self.home))
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        from hermes_constants import reset_hermes_home_override
+        self.registry.deregister(self.name, scope=str(self.home))
+        reset_hermes_home_override(self.token)
+        self.directory.cleanup()
+
+    def call(self, name, arguments, *, enabled=None):
+        return json.loads(self.dispatch(name, arguments,
+            enabled_toolsets=[self.toolset] if enabled is None else enabled,
+            disabled_toolsets=self.disabled))
+
+    def invoke(self, arguments, *, enabled=None, name=None):
+        return self.call("tool_call", {"calls": [
+            {"name": name or self.name, "arguments": arguments}]}, enabled=enabled)
+
+    def test_model_bridge_describes_exact_union_without_mutating_provider_schemas(self):
+        from tools.schema_sanitizer import sanitize_tool_schemas
+        raw = {"type": "function", "function": copy.deepcopy(self.schema)}
+        sanitized = sanitize_tool_schemas([raw])[0]
+        self.assertNotIn("oneOf", sanitized["function"]["parameters"])
+        definitions = self.definitions(enabled_toolsets=[self.toolset],
+            disabled_toolsets=self.disabled, quiet_mode=True)
+        names = {item["function"]["name"] for item in definitions}
+        self.assertTrue({"tool_search", "tool_describe", "tool_call"} <= names)
+        self.assertNotIn(self.name, names)
+        described = self.call("tool_describe", {"names": [self.name]})
+        self.assertEqual(described["tools"][self.name]["parameters"], self.parameters)
+        self.assertEqual(self.registry.get_entry(self.name).schema, self.schema)
+        self.assertEqual(sanitize_tool_schemas([raw])[0], sanitized)
+        self.assertEqual(self.calls, [])
+
+    def test_valid_union_branches_reach_only_the_normal_dispatcher(self):
+        for arguments in [{"action": "status"},
+                          {"action": "acknowledge_result", "result": {"digest": "a" * 64}}]:
+            self.assertEqual(self.invoke(arguments), {"inert": True, "arguments": arguments})
+        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls), 2)
+
+    def test_configured_cli_mcp_alias_keeps_the_normal_oneshot_selection(self):
+        from hermes_cli.tools_config import _get_platform_tools
+        alias = self.toolset.removeprefix("mcp-")
+        self.registry.register_toolset_alias(alias, self.toolset)
+        config = {"platform_toolsets": {"cli": [alias]}, "mcp_servers": {
+            alias: {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:1/mcp", "auth": "oauth"}}}
+        (self.home / "config.yaml").write_text(json.dumps(config))
+        selected = sorted(_get_platform_tools(config, "cli"))
+        self.assertEqual(selected, [alias])
+        from toolsets import resolve_toolset
+        self.assertIn(self.name, resolve_toolset(alias))
+        definitions = self.definitions(enabled_toolsets=selected,
+            disabled_toolsets=self.disabled, quiet_mode=True)
+        self.assertIn("tool_describe", {row["function"]["name"] for row in definitions})
+        described = self.call("tool_describe", {"names": [self.name]}, enabled=selected)
+        self.assertEqual(described["tools"][self.name]["parameters"], self.parameters)
+        self.assertEqual(self.calls, [])
+
+    def test_invalid_union_branches_never_invoke_the_handler(self):
+        for arguments in [{"action": "not_an_action"}, {"action": "acknowledge_result"},
+                          {"action": "acknowledge_result", "result": {"digest": "wrong"}},
+                          {"action": "status", "extra": True}]:
+            with self.subTest(arguments=arguments):
+                self.assertIn("error", self.invoke(arguments))
+        self.assertEqual(self.calls, [])
+
+    def test_unknown_and_outside_session_tools_stay_undisclosed_and_uncallable(self):
+        missing = self.name + "_unknown"
+        for name, enabled in [(missing, [self.toolset]), (self.name, [])]:
+            with self.subTest(name=name, enabled=enabled):
+                described = self.call("tool_describe", {"names": [name]}, enabled=enabled)
+                self.assertNotIn(name, described["tools"])
+                self.assertIn("error", self.invoke({"action": "status"}, enabled=enabled, name=name))
+        self.assertEqual(self.calls, [])
+
+    def test_same_name_in_another_profile_is_not_borrowed(self):
+        from hermes_constants import set_hermes_home_override, reset_hermes_home_override
+        sibling = Path(self.directory.name) / "sibling"
+        sibling.mkdir()
+        (sibling / "config.yaml").write_text("{}\n")
+        token = set_hermes_home_override(sibling)
+        try:
+            self.assertIsNone(self.registry.get_entry(self.name))
+            described = self.call("tool_describe", {"names": [self.name]})
+            self.assertNotIn(self.name, described["tools"])
+            self.assertIn("error", self.invoke({"action": "status"}))
+        finally:
+            reset_hermes_home_override(token)
+        self.assertEqual(self.calls, [])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
